note: Attacker bytes are copied verbatim into the mutable request buffer used by the parser.
The fuzz harness enables PROXY protocol parsing for the supplied input.
The request parser dispatches the attacker-controlled buffer into the PROXY protocol parser before normal HTTP parsing.
A v2 signature routes execution into the vulnerable PROXY v2 header parser.
The parser derives the claimed header size directly from the untrusted length field.
The bounds check only rejects sizes larger than the struct, so an exactly-sized but incomplete or malformed layout can still proceed.
The parser copies address fields out of the attacker-controlled header into the proxy address structure, reaching the unsafe sink when the crafted layout overruns the available buffer interpretation.
